categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Has the P2P label and modifies peer ping timeout handling in `src/net_processing.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Prevents nodes with constrained bandwidth from spuriously disconnecting fast peers during initial block download. Under low bandwidth, peers prioritize block transmission over responding to pings, causing downloading nodes to drop valid peers after 20 minutes even though 'they have done nothing wrong' (#35761). Eliminating these disconnects improves IBD reliability and connection stability.
